Definition: diminutive from G2486; a petty fish:--little (small) fish.
BiblicalUsage: Little fishes are what the disciples had when the crowds were hungry, and Jesus took them anyway. In Matthew 15:34 the disciples count seven loaves and a few little fishes, and in Mark 8:7 they had a few small fishes, and Jesus blessed them and commanded them to be set before the people.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the little fishes are the whole point of the story: what we have is never enough until Jesus takes it, and then it always is.
